quizItems.scenario: Several desks have monitors still on and chairs pulled out, but the room is empty.
quizItems.question: Rank these actions best to worst.

options.text: Treat as recently occupied; check adjoining rooms before clearing the area.
Note it, then clear this room and continue the pattern search.
Clear the room without comment.
Assume everyone already evacuated based on the empty room.

quizItems.rationale: Powered equipment and disturbed furniture suggest occupants left in a hurry and may be nearby; assuming full evacuation from one empty room is the worst read.

quizItems.scenario: A server rack in the corner is sparking intermittently.
quizItems.question: Rank these actions best to worst.

options.text: De-energize the circuit, then flag as an electrical hazard.
Flag the hazard and avoid the area without de-energizing.
Apply water-based suppression directly to the sparking rack.
Ignore it and continue the primary search through that corner.

quizItems.rationale: Cutting power is the correct first step for an electrical fire; water on a live circuit is the clearly worst option (electrocution risk).

quizItems.scenario: A receptionist's desk has a phone off the hook and a half-finished drink.
quizItems.question: Rank these actions best to worst.

options.text: Treat as recently occupied; the receptionist may be deeper in the building.
Note it and continue the planned search pattern.
Assume the receptionist already left through the front door.
Disregard the desk entirely as irrelevant.

quizItems.rationale: Signs of a hastily-abandoned post suggest the occupant went further in rather than out; assuming they safely left is the riskiest read.

quizItems.scenario: The room is clear of visible fire but has moderate smoke and reduced visibility.
quizItems.question: Rank these actions best to worst.

options.text: Complete a hands-on primary search before moving to the next room.
Do a quick visual scan from the doorway, then move on.
Glance in briefly and mark it cleared.
Skip the room entirely based on the doorway view.

quizItems.rationale: Reduced visibility still needs a hands-on primary search; skipping a room from a doorway glance is the worst option.
